skill_name: Compare and contrast blockchain and distributed ledger technology.
workflow: Blockchain and distributed ledger technology (DLT) are both based on the idea of a peer-to-peer, decentralized network of computers. The primary difference between them is that a blockchain allows for the transfer and storage of digital tokens and other digital assets, while distributed ledger technology allows users to transfer and store digital records.
